summary: George Russell sets the pace in Friday practice as Mercedes hunts momentum in Baku's high-speed battles, but rookie sensation Antonelli's championship lead puts him squarely in the crosshairs this weekend. Isack Hadjar's return from wrist injury injects uncertainty into Red Bull's strategy, potentially reshuffling the midfield hierarchy on a circuit that punishes setup errors. A strong result here could extend Antonelli's title advantage or hand a challenger the momentum needed to claw back points before the season's final stretch.
